method: Recovered angle configs for rendered-only clips, EXPERIMENTAL. True-final angles are DOCUMENTED (not estimated). Fighting and punch angles are MEASURED-ESTIMATES from viewing the renders, +/-15 degrees, labelled as such — they are sufficient to run the snap gate (which needs angles, not builder-exact values), but they are NOT claimed to be the original builder inputs.
note_on_punch_render: punch-impact-locked-v7c.png carries red numbered ARM/LEG circles — those are DEBUG labels only, never part of a clean scene, per the labels-are-debug-only rule. The gate result above is about angles, not about that labelled render being clean.

poses.eye_check: fists near head, not over face; elbows out, upper at side, not eaten; viewed
poses.name: fighting-pose-forward-bicep-curl-gauntlet-out-fixed

poses.eye_check: documented angles; fists above shoulders, not over face; viewed
poses.name: true-final-flex-relaxed-clean
poses.status: DOCUMENTED (uppers -85/+85, forearms 145/-145, fists -70/+70 pose-space, dip 28px, legs -22/22, lower 10/-10)

poses.eye_check: extended arm horizontal, other arm crossed chest below head; L cowl-candidate is a FALSE POSITIVE on eye-check (upper out to the side, not cut by collar); R chest is a warning only (forearm already in front)
poses.gate: PASS (L COWL-CANDIDATE with eye-check recorded, R CHEST-SNAP warning only)
poses.name: punch-impact-locked

remaining_gap: Other clips-v7c rendered frames (walk/dance/flying/jump families) still have no angle configs on disk; they remain eye-checked only until their configs are recorded the same way. Do not claim the whole clips-v7c set is gated — only the three poses above are.
